llm_proposer.assessment: The evidence indicates a brief impairment of the shared 400G lightpath och124 rather than a persistent customer-port failure. The immediate protection switch and restoration at t=600, one-second error counts, unchanged sampled optical metrics, and recent S21 maintenance most strongly suggest a transient mechanical disturbance near S21 on the S21-to-S10 fibre path.

proposals.rationale: A disturbance on the first S21-to-S10 span near recently maintained S21 could cause a sub-second or one-second power excursion affecting och124 and all three impacted services, while triggering svc277's brief switch and restoration. Sampled OCM, amplifier, and coherent metrics may miss such a short excursion, although the absence of effects on other channels sharing the span argues against a large disturbance.

Receiver-local degradation at the S10 end of och124 could produce line errored seconds while optical power and OSNR remain normal, affecting all tributaries carried over this lightpath. It less readily explains the indication at both line ends, and the unchanged pre-FEC BER weakens this diagnosis.

A channel-specific filter impairment at the recently maintained S21 ROADM could degrade och124 without changing measured channel power and leave other channels and services unaffected. A persistent shift should normally have raised pre-FEC BER or reduced estimated margin at S10, neither of which changed.
proposals.note: site named; resolved to its node equipment

proposals.rationale: A failure of the S10 och124 line card could interrupt both its received traffic and its transmitted channel, accounting for bidirectional service effects on the tributaries of och124. However, the event appears very brief and the card's monitoring remained valid rather than becoming silent, strongly arguing against a hard card failure.

An S21 switch-fabric disturbance could affect multiple ODUs without an optical-power signature. It is unlikely because numerous other services through S21 remained healthy and och124 itself recorded line errored seconds.
